brands.name: ACSOD Surfboards
brands.location_label: Tweed Heads South, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Performance shortboards, twins, and step-ups shaped at The Glass Lab on the Tweed Coast — ACSOD has refined its lineup since 2010.

models.description: Introducing the "2000," our latest addition to our esteemed HI-Performance range. Drawing inspiration from our roots, we've reinvigorated an early shortboard design from ACSOD's inception in 2010, infusing it with new design elements honed over years of experience. The result? An all-around performance board that embodies speed, agility, and unparalleled responsiveness - the "2000." Distinguished by its refined features and our original bear logo, the "2000" stands apart from its counterparts like the White Ferrari with a more pronounced curve in the outline, a deep single concave bottom, a straighter/flatter tail rocker, and strategically placed foam under the chest. Beneath your feet, the "2000" surfs with instant acceleration. Its enhanced drive off the bottom and seamless release through the lip allow for a progressive approach. Thanks to its flatter tail rocker, this board effortlessly planes through flat sections, while the single concave ensures speed down the line. Designed to thrive in 2-6ft beach breaks, points, or reefs, the "2000" is your ultimate all-around performance companion. When you order the "2000," we recommend sticking to the dimensions of your standard shortboard.

models.name: TWO FANGS
models.description: The Two Fangs. A board that all have loved since its inception in 2016. Coming into 2021, we had one question off the back of the Two Fangs success. How do we make something great even better? After putting one under the feet of surfing icon Mick Fanning, he had some feedback we couldn’t ignore. “little more lift in the nose and pull the outline in a touch”. These two minor changes were the catalyst of the improvement we were looking for. The Two Fangs just got better. An already rippable twin is now even more rippable. The same fluid speed and glide of the original design, the same performance flare, yet now with a slight increase in nose rocker and pulled-in nose outline. Allowing you to surf tighter top to bottom, wrench heavier arches and make steeper drops than before.

models.name: SLOW BURN
models.description: The Slow Burn is a unique split keel quad for the open-minded surfer. Best suited to clean running beach breaks or points in the 1-4ft range. The Slow Burn offers a unique feeling underfoot with its "hydro-hull" bottom contours. The "hydro-hull" Is a double concave that cuts through the bottom of the board, adding lift and speed. The chined angles on the rails add release, freeing up the board from rail to rail, allowing a tighter radius. Paired with a split keel quad, this board flies. The Slow Burn makes for an enjoyable alternative board you can glide around and draw different lines. A great option if you are looking for something different to the norm and want to add some spice to your surfing. (This model no longer comes with a cedar stringer)

models.name: GHOST
models.description: The Ghost is a consistent all-rounder you can rely on for everyday surf. A little flatter in the rocker, a little wider in the outline, has fuller forgiving rails and a little more volume than the White Ferrari. Although this makes a more relaxed and forgiving shortboard, the Ghost is still packed with speed, release and responsiveness. Allowing you to surf with a performance approach but with a more user-friendly feel.

models.name: EASY RIDER
models.description: The name says it all! The "Easy Rider" is our most user-friendly model in the range. Its wide outline, generous foam distribution, full/boxy rails and subtle concaves make this board perfect for any intermediate to beginner looking to take their surfing to the next level. The Easy Rider has heaps of paddle power and generates speed effortlessly. The wide outline creates great stability underfoot and adds lift in weak surf. Although designed with easy surf-ability in mind, the ER maintains enough performance to allow for good transitional surfing to help progression.

models.name: Monster
models.description: The Monster is our go-to step-down model for performance surfing in below-average conditions. Short, stubby and wide, the Monster is ridden 3 to 4 inches shorter than your standard high-performance board. A generous amount of foam is distributed throughout the model, adding paddle power and helping to generate speed in weak surf. Boxy rails add a forgiving feeling through your turns and prevent catching. This is the perfect board if you're after something short, stubby and high in volume but will surf fast and lively with that familiar performance feel of a standard shortboard.

models.name: BLUE LOTUS
models.description: Modelling as a semi-step-up/all-rounder in the new "Lotus Series". The Blue Lotus came about via repeat customers wanting to transfer the magic, retro fun of the original Lotus into a longer, stretched-out version that could handle bigger surf over the 4ft+ range. Keeping the original Lotus's characteristics as a base, I increased the length and added a rounded pintail for hold. The added length creates a narrower outline curve, giving you more drive and control. The entry and exit rocker have been lifted to fit into a steeper, suckier wave face, the chimed rails are slightly lowered for engagement in bigger surf, and I kept the exact bottom contours as the original Lotus to maintain the same lively speed. After much testing, we have made an effortless board to surf with heaps of paddle power and maintains the same lively performance as the original Lotus in smaller surf but with a smoother, more controlled feeling underfoot when the surfer is overhead.

models.name: FOX
models.description: The FOX is the smaller/stubby version of its sibling model, the "Fox Tail". It is a fun, fast 2 + 1 twin fin designed for high-performance surfing in average conditions. It's packed with speed and fast twitch manoeuvrability and makes some grindy conditions fun. A generous amount of foam is hidden along the stringer line and distributed evenly through the teardrop-style outline. This alows you to ride this board 4 to 5 inches shorter than your performance board. Nice medium/boxy rails give this board a great balance of forgiveness and bite. The bottom shape consists of a medium single concave that runs through the belly, transitioning into a double concave between the fins, ending with a vee exit. This combination is the engine that generates the magic speed this board has on offer. Although intended for small waves, the FOX still holds its own in solid head-high conditions due to the narrow tail. The perfect addition to the quiver for any twin fin enthusiast.

models.name: The Axe
models.description: The Axe is a staple in the board bag for our team and customers when it comes to serious surf. Tried & tested in a variety of locations like Pipeline and backdoor to Nias and all over Indo. The subtle, key features make the magic DNA of this step up. Smooth full rocker, slight single to double concave, low soft rails and precise volume distribution combine to get you in early, harness the power of the wave and control it. Confidence in your equipment means confidence in the water.

models.name: FOX TAIL
models.description: The big brother of the original "Fox" design comes the FOX TAIL , a stretched-out version that harnesses the speed of the original design and channels it into a smoother, drawn-out twin fin. We've updated this model coming into the 2023-24 summer. Firstly, dropping the length down from a mid-length size to now be ridden one inch shorter than your performance board. The second was tweaking the bottom shape. We flattened out the entry and placed a subtle double concave in front of the fins, blending into vee off the tail. We also lifted the tail rocker, creating more manuvrabilty. Finally, we dressed it up with a classic red tint, our 90's inspired ACSOD logo and a tapered pinline for some traditional flare. Underfoot, the FOX TAIL surfs with instant speed out the gate due to the low-entry rocker and effortlessly maintains this speed when planning over flat sections. The longer rail line adds drive and holds through craves, whilst the vee of the tail and lifted exit rocker allow the board to roll from rail to rail and turn tighter in the pocket. Creating a very seamless transition in and out of maneuvers. A domed deck hides a generous amount of volume to aid in paddle power, and the shorter length also assists tighter turns in the pocket. For twin fin enthusiasts, this is the perfect complement to its sibling model, the "Fox" . Everything you love about the stubby, rippable small wave twin, but stretched out for a drawn-out fluid approach, suitable for 2ft to 6ft points, reef or beach breaks.

models.name: LOTUS
models.description: The ultimate ode to the classic 80s flat deck thruster design. The Lotus has been specifically crafted to combine all the original design elements that made the 80s thruster a classic while adding a modern twist to reinvigorate this classic design. The Lotus features a bump flyer, beak nose, low smooth rocker, and flat deck with chimed-down rails - all the hallmarks of the classic 80s thruster design. But we've added a modern twist by tweaking the traditional flat or vee bottom. Keeping a little vee in the nose to prevent catching, we've added a shallow single concave under your chest that blends into an aggressive double concave between the fins, finishing with a flat exit. These changes have replaced a slow, rail-to-rail roll with more lift and speed. The Lotus surf with instant speed out the gate and a wide range of maneuverability for tight surfing in the pocket. The chimed-down rails add hold and drive, allowing you to push hard through your snaps and carves. Our most popular model to date, the Lotus will add some retro fun to your quiver and make the day-to-day surf exciting and fun.

models.name: WHITE FERRARI
models.description: The White Ferrari - the ultimate board for surfers who demand the best. The White Ferrari features a modern, high-performance shape specifically designed to meet the needs of experienced surfers. The board's outline is sleek and streamlined, with a pulled-in nose and tail that perfectly balance speed and control. The White Ferrari has a full rocker perfect for steep, bowly waves. This rocker lets you quickly draw deep bottom turns and perform tight maneuvers in the pocket while maintaining a good amount of release for progressive, fins-free surfing. The board's rails are also vital to this model's magic. They're low and sharp, providing maximum bite and control when carving through tight arcs and wraps. Finished with a perfect balance of volume and foil, the White Ferrari is ideal for anyone looking to take their surfing to the next level and perform in quality surf.
